whenToUse: A properties panel in an editor, or a filter panel beside a list.
People often need the main content wide.
People open and close the side area often.
whenNotToUse: Small screens (open it as a drawer or bottom sheet).
Information people glance at and close (use a popover).

alternatives.name: Drawer
alternatives.reason: A panel opened over the screen.

accessibility: The toggle button has aria-expanded and aria-controls, and its name changes between "Collapse properties panel" and "Expand properties panel".
Collapsed content is hidden, so it's skipped by Tab and screen readers.
The panel is a named aside landmark.
The width transition turns off with reduced motion.
